Compared with the earlier unmerged six-case proposal, main now emits decision/knowledge events and swordsman/sky-mage reaches its configured 6000-step draw (2460 events; 8763519 log bytes). The new seer/ember case completes its configured 250-step draw (221 events; 690710 log bytes). This preserves approved main behavior and all existing Golden/boundary expectations. These are regression ceilings, not product capacity or wall-time/RSS guarantees. Failed/missing baseline observations cannot be waived.
